parts.name: body shell

physics.Basic_description: The main white housing of the printer, featuring a matte plastic finish and enclosing the internal mechanisms.
physics.Functional_description: Provides structural support and protection for the internal printing components and electronics.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the sturdy side walls or top edges of the shell to lift or move the entire printer unit.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic housing encloses a large air cavity for mechanics; treating as solid would vastly overestimate mass.

parts.description: The main white housing of the printer, featuring a matte plastic finish and enclosing the internal mechanisms.
parts.function: Provides structural support and protection for the internal printing components and electronics.

parts.name: output shadow

physics.Basic_description: A dark grey or black plastic section at the base of the output area, likely part of the lower chassis molding.
physics.Functional_description: Forms the lower boundary of the paper exit path and adds visual contrast to the design.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp target; too low and integrated into the base structure.
physics.reason: Part of the thin-walled plastic chassis assembly.

parts.description: A dark grey or black plastic section at the base of the output area, likely part of the lower chassis molding.

parts.name: brand plate

parts.description: A small blue rectangular badge or logo plate on the front left of the printer body.

parts.name: badge roundel

physics.Basic_description: A small circular yellow button or indicator light on the front right panel.
physics.Functional_description: Likely a power indicator or status light.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; it is a small interface element.

parts.description: A small circular yellow button or indicator light on the front right panel.

parts.name: scanner glass

physics.Basic_description: A flat, black, reflective rectangular surface located under the open lid, representing the scanner bed.
physics.Functional_description: Transparent surface where documents are placed for scanning or copying.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; fragile and prone to fingerprints/smudges.
physics.reason: Scanner platen glass is a solid sheet, typically 2-4mm thick.

parts.description: A flat, black, reflective rectangular surface located under the open lid, representing the scanner bed.

physics.Basic_description: A grey plastic structural component at the rear top, supporting the paper feed mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Guides paper into the rear feeding path.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a stable grasp point; located at the rear and potentially flimsy.
physics.reason: Molded plastic guide structure with internal ribs and air space.

parts.description: A grey plastic structural component at the rear top, supporting the paper feed mechanism.

physics.Basic_description: A vertical grey plastic wall or support at the rear paper input area.

parts.description: A vertical grey plastic wall or support at the rear paper input area.

parts.name: rear feed paper

physics.Basic_description: A stack of white paper sheets loaded into the rear feed slot.

parts.description: A stack of white paper sheets loaded into the rear feed slot.

parts.name: output shelf

physics.Basic_description: A grey plastic tray extending from the front bottom of the printer body.
physics.Functional_description: Catches and supports printed pages as they exit the printer.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
